suite: Dollar Shave Club Customer Support Scenarios

turns.speaker: agent
turns.expected_behavior: Politely ask for email or order number.
turns.sample_response: Hey there! I can definitely track that down for you. Do you mind sharing the email address on your Dollar Shave Club account, or your order number?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.expected_behavior: Report order DSC-8832 in transit, tracking 1Z99999999999999, arriving tomorrow by 8 PM.
turns.sample_response: Thanks, Alex! It looks like your order (DSC-8832) is currently in transit. The tracking number is 1Z99999999999999, and it's scheduled to arrive tomorrow by 8 PM. Anything else I can help you with?

turns.speaker: user
turns.utterance: Actually yeah. I just got my starter set a week ago, why does my account say I'm getting billed again next week?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.expected_behavior: Explain Starter Set trial schedule, first full-size Restock Box two weeks later to avoid running out of blades, regular monthly/bi-monthly schedule, option to delay from account page before billing on October 15.
turns.sample_response: Ah, the classic Starter Set confusion! Don't worry, you aren't being double-billed. Because the Starter Set is just a trial, we schedule your first full-size Restock Box two weeks later so you don't run out of fresh blades. After that, it switches to a regular monthly or bi-monthly schedule. If you need more time, you can easily delay that Restock Box right from your account page before it bills on October 15.

turns.speaker: user
turns.utterance: Hi. My tracking hasn't moved in days. jamie@example.com

turns.speaker: agent
turns.expected_behavior: Pull order DSC-9104, identify carrier hasn't scanned in >4 days, declare lost in transit, and offer free replacement.
turns.sample_response: Hey Jamie. Let me take a look at that for you. Pulling up order DSC-9104... Oof, you're right. I see the carrier hasn't scanned your package in over 4 days. Sometimes packages go rogue, but we've got your back. Since it's officially lost in transit, I'm going to go ahead and process a free replacement order for you right now.

turns.speaker: user
turns.utterance: Awesome, thank you. Can you also send it to a different address? I'm moving.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.expected_behavior: Acknowledge urgency before processing, prompt for new address.
turns.sample_response: We need to be quick to catch it before it processes! Since this is a brand new replacement, I can update the shipping address for this order and your future boxes. What’s the new address?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.expected_behavior: Update address to 123 Main St, Austin TX 78701 in database, submit replacement order, promise new tracking email.
turns.sample_response: Got it. I've updated your address to 123 Main St, Austin TX 78701 and submitted the replacement order. You'll get a new tracking email shortly.

scenarios.title: Damaged Item & Secure Payment Link Workflow

turns.speaker: user
turns.utterance: Hey, chris@example.com here. Two things. First, my Shave Butter exploded in the box. Second, I need to change my credit card before my next box.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.expected_behavior: Apologize for Shave Butter explosion, process free replacement (ships in 24h), note bill date is tomorrow, strictly refuse taking card over chat, and dispatch secure Shop Pay link via text & email.
turns.sample_response:
Hey Chris. First off, I'm so sorry about the Shave Butter explosion—that is definitely not the unboxing experience we want for you. I'm processing a free replacement for the Shave Butter right now; it'll ship out within 24 hours.

As for the card, your next bill date is actually tomorrow! Since we can't take credit card numbers securely over chat, I just texted and emailed a secure Shop Pay link to the contact info on your file. Just click that link to update your card, and you'll be all set for tomorrow's billing.

turns.speaker: user
turns.utterance: I want to cancel my subscription. alex@example.com

turns.speaker: agent
turns.expected_behavior: Offer retention pitch: delay next box or change how often they receive restocks before canceling.
turns.sample_response: Hey Alex! We'd hate to see you go. Before canceling completely, did you know you can easily delay your next box or change how often you receive them? For example, we could push your next box out by a month or switch you to every 2 or 3 months so you only get blades when you actually need them.

turns.speaker: user
turns.utterance: Oh that's great, let's switch to every 3 months instead of canceling.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.expected_behavior: Update delivery cadence to Every 3 Months and confirm active membership benefits.
turns.sample_response: Done! I've updated your delivery schedule to Every 3 Months. Your membership remains active and your next box will arrive right on your new schedule.

scenarios.title: Damaged Product Photo Upload & Visual Analysis

turns.speaker: user
turns.utterance: My order arrived damaged. The Shave Butter exploded everywhere. chris@example.com

turns.speaker: agent
turns.expected_behavior: Apologize and prompt customer to upload a photo of the damaged product.
turns.sample_response: I'm so sorry about that! That is definitely not the Dollar Shave Club experience we want for you. Please upload a quick photo of the damaged item using the attachment button so we can validate the damage and rush a replacement to you.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.expected_behavior: Analyze uploaded photo, validate physical damage (EXPLODED_CONTAINER), and confirm free replacement order queued.
turns.sample_response: Thanks for sharing the photo! Our visual analysis verified the ruptured Shave Butter seal. I've automatically authorized and queued a free replacement order (DSC-7721-R1) to ship to your address within 24 hours.

turns.speaker: user
turns.utterance: My order arrived at the wrong address! jamie@example.com

turns.speaker: agent
turns.expected_behavior: Empathize with delivery mishap, look up order, ask for verified destination address.
turns.sample_response: I'm so sorry to hear that! Deliveries to the wrong address are super frustrating, but we'll take care of it right away. What is your correct current shipping address?

turns.speaker: user
turns.utterance: My correct address is 999 New Street, Seattle WA 98102

turns.speaker: agent
turns.expected_behavior: Update address and queue free replacement order.
turns.sample_response: I've updated your shipping address to 999 New Street, Seattle WA 98102 and rushed a free replacement order to you. You'll receive a new tracking number as soon as it leaves our warehouse.
